I'm Amisha Vatsa, a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University in Melbourne. I come from a biotechnology background, with a B.Tech (Honours) from VIT Vellore, and I'm now focused on working with data to support better decisions.

My technical skills include R, Python, SQL, Quarto, and Excel. I've co-authored two academic publications, which has helped me practise explaining complex work to different audiences.
